d: Russia's Pacific Fleet has fired the Bulava Intercontinental Ballistic Missile from the Sea of Okhotsk. The launch took place just north of Japan. The Bulava was fired from a Borei-class nuclear-powered submarine called the Generalissimo Suvorov, which can carry 16 Bulava missiles at one time. The last time Vladimir Putin's forces test-fired a missile from the Sea of Okhotsk was in October, 2025. Since then, most ICBM launches were carried out using ground based silos.
